about: Known differences between vibeBMS and beatoraja in the behaviour cases (compare.py). kind: intended (vibeBMS's rules say so: rules names the docs/RULES.md section), vibebms-bug (vibeBMS should change; listed so that the run tells new differences from it), harness (the comparison's, not the players'). A difference not listed fails the run.

differences.reason: a back-spin scratch (scratch CN / HCN) let go at its end on the keyboard: vibeBMS ends it there (PGREAT), beatoraja 0.8.9 gives the end a POOR (only turning the other way ends it, as the case's other trials show); this answers open gap B3
differences.rules: Long notes (keyboards: releasing also ends it); LR2 equivalence, The beatoraja profile (B3)

differences.reason: an LN (LN mode) pressed 40 ms early and let go on time is a GREAT in both, FAST in beatoraja; vibeBMS counts it neither FAST nor SLOW: its early-release wait (Engine::release, the pending judgement) keeps the release's timing (0) instead of the head's
